lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: Hi Leila! Sorry to bother you, do you happen to have the official tracking number for the school publication’s frozen operational fund? I'm trying to fix a letter for Mrs. Santos.

lines.speaker: Leila
lines.text: Oh! Let me check my student council binder.. Oh no! It’s not here… I must have forgotten it in one of the corridor terraces! Can you perhaps.. Uh... get it for me?

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: Seriously??... Ughh. Fine.. All for that code.

lines.speaker: Leila
lines.text: Have you found it? I was just getting some air as I remember, but uhh… I'm not so sure now...

lines.speaker: Leila
lines.text: Aha! Here it is. Thank you so so much… Now let me find the code.. It's uhh… listed under code 'MGT-2004-FIN'.

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: MGT-2004-FIN.. Got it. Thanks, Leila! This is exactly what I needed to make this letter ironclad.

lines.speaker: Leila
lines.text: Good luck with that letter! Word around the office is that Mr. Reyes is tightening the purse strings for all student organizations this year.

lines.speaker: Leila
